fields.label: Value
fields.description: Raw value as stored on Item Ecommerce Property rows — verbatim match. The migration deduplicates values per Group. Small Text (not Data) because some catalog values exceed the 140-char Data limit.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Order within the group on the storefront. Seed value is row idx * 10 so the operator can drop new options in between without renumbering.

fields.label: Display (DE)
fields.description: Optional friendly label shown in the storefront. Falls back to value when empty.
